test_title: PYST 2: SSC CGL Tier - II (English) (Held on: 3 Feb 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Anju said to me, “What are you doing next weekend?”

options.text: Anju asked me what I had done the following weekend.
Anju asked me what I am doing the coming weekend.
Anju asked me what are you doing next weekend.
Anju asked me what I was doing the following weekend.

solution:
The indirect speech of the given sentence is__ **Anju asked me what I was doing the following weekend.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
 

 
 
Anju said to me, 

 
 
 
What are you doing next weekend?

 
 
 

__Reporting clause__ __Reported speech__

__
 
• When the reporting speech is in **present continuous **tense then all the speech Changes according to past continuous tense..

 
 
• is/are/am doing------was/were doing
 
 
 
• Said to of the reporting verb changed into asked as the reported speech is a kind of question.
 
• Remove comma (,) and inverted commas (" ") 
 
• Change the words expressing nearness in time or places(next) of the direct speech into the appropriate words expressing distance(following)

 

​**So, the final sentence is**: Anju asked me what I was doing the following weekend. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Words expressing nearness in time or places are generally changed into words expressing distance.

 
 

 **Direct Speech Word**
 **Indirect Speech Word**
